title: Great Luna Moth
html:
A level 42 Moth that attacks with stab (melee).

Fighting it

Weak slashfreeze   Resists crushshock

Reagent: Moonwing Dust (infuses an enchant). A small chance on any kill, far better from elites. Reforging
